VERDICT: FAIL

The self-report describes fixing an integer-overflow/wraparound issue, which is a different defect than the specified off-by-one boundary error that skips the last record. The diagnosis doesn't match the task, no artifact (diff, CI log) is attached to verify the fix or the "118 tests pass" claim, and the report even mentions only 118 tests after "adding two regressions," which is internally inconsistent with the original count. The acceptance criteria cannot be confirmed satisfied.
